column1: # Volt's English glossary, seeded from the localization inventory's starter glossary (english-and-safety).
# D3 (terminology cleanup) finalizes it. One matchable term per row; where the source uses several names
# for one thing, each name has its own row and the alias rows say which term they belong to.
# Columns: id, English term, definition, part of speech, do-not-translate (yes/no), safety flag (a
# volt:safety value or -), source location (src/com/jjricks/volt/ unless a path is given).
# A one-word adjective row whose id is another row's id plus a suffix (energy-recovery-off) is one
# value of that setting; it is required only where the text is the value alone or names the setting.
